scenarios.title: A｜请求重复
scenarios.setting: 在“没听懂医生”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“请求重复”。

turns.text: I’d like you to take this medication twice daily and come back if the symptoms persist.

turns.prompt: 你想确认听到的信息，会怎样请对方重复或拼写？

choices.text: Sorry, could you say that again a little more slowly?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, could you say that again a little more slowly?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Sorry, I didn’t quite catch that. Could you repeat it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, I didn’t quite catch that. Could you repeat it?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Could you explain that again, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain that again, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: What do you mean by “persist”?

feedback.naturalExpression: What do you mean by “persist”?
feedback.explanation: 直接指出没理解的词或说法，让对方解释该部分，而不必重讲全部内容。

choices.text: Please repeat again.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, could you say that again a little more slowly?
feedback.explanation: “repeat”已经表示再说一次，“again”通常可省略；请求别人重复可说“Could you repeat that?”。

turns.text: Of course. Take the medicine twice a day. If you’re still feeling sick after a few days, come back.

turns.prompt: 你想复述医嘱，并进一步确认服药方式，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, so twice a day. Should I take it with food?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, so twice a day. Should I take it with food?
feedback.explanation: “with food”在服药问答中指与食物同服；用这个短语确认服用要求，比只问何时吃药更具体。

choices.text: Got it. And how many days should I take it for?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. And how many days should I take it for?
feedback.explanation: “How many”询问可数事物的数量，后面通常接复数名词。

choices.text: So if I’m not getting better, I should come back?

feedback.naturalExpression: So if I’m not getting better, I should come back?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

scenarios.title: B｜询问检查结果
scenarios.setting: 在“没听懂医生”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问检查结果”。

turns.text: I’ve looked at your test results.

turns.prompt: 你想请医生解释检查结果，会怎么说？

choices.text: What did the results show?

feedback.naturalExpression: What did the results show?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Is everything okay?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is everything okay?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Did the tests find anything unusual?

feedback.naturalExpression: Did the tests find anything unusual?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Could you explain the results to me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain the results to me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: What result did I get?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: What did the results show?
feedback.explanation: 就诊查结果常说“test results”；“What result did I get?”没有说明是哪项检查。

turns.text: Nothing serious showed up. There are some signs of inflammation, though.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: What does that mean?

feedback.naturalExpression: What does that mean?
feedback.explanation: “does that mean”根据刚得到的信息核对含义，给对方纠正理解的机会。

choices.text: Is that something I should be worried about?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is that something I should be worried about?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: What could be causing the inflammation?

feedback.naturalExpression: What could be causing the inflammation?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: Do I need any more tests?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need any more tests?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

turns.text: Not right now. I’d like to see how you respond to treatment first.

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: Okay. When should I come back?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. When should I come back?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: What symptoms should I watch out for?

feedback.naturalExpression: What symptoms should I watch out for?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: And if it doesn’t improve, should I make another appointment?

feedback.naturalExpression: And if it doesn’t improve, should I make another appointment?
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

scenarios.title: C｜确认接下来怎么办
scenarios.setting: 在“没听懂医生”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“确认接下来怎么办”。

turns.text: For now, I’d like you to rest and take the medication I’ve prescribed.

turns.prompt: 你想了解回家后需要怎样照顾自己，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Just to make sure I understand, what should I do when I get home?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Just to make sure I understand, what should I do when I get home?
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: Could you go over the instructions one more time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you go over the instructions one more time?
feedback.explanation: “more / extra / another”表示在已有数量上增加，能说明是补充需求。

choices.text: So I should rest and take the medication as prescribed?

feedback.naturalExpression: So I should rest and take the medication as prescribed?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Is there anything I should avoid doing?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything I should avoid doing?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: What should I do next step?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Just to make sure I understand, what should I do when I get home?
feedback.explanation: 问接下来怎么做用“What should I do next?”；若用“step”，则说“What’s the next step?”。

turns.text: Take one tablet twice a day with food, drink plenty of fluids, and get some rest.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: How long should I keep taking the medication?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long should I keep taking the medication?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Are there any side effects I should watch for?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any side effects I should watch for?
feedback.explanation: “side effects”指药物的副作用，能把所问的影响说得更具体。

choices.text: Can I take it with my other medications?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I take it with my other medications?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: When should I expect to start feeling better?

feedback.naturalExpression: When should I expect to start feeling better?
feedback.explanation: “when should I expect”询问预计何时会发生，适合确认到账、送达等需要等待的事项。

turns.text: If you’re not improving after a few days, or if your symptoms get worse, contact the clinic again.

turns.prompt: 你想确认哪些变化意味着症状加重，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. And what would count as getting worse?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. And what would count as getting worse?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: Got it. If things don’t improve, I’ll contact the clinic.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. If things don’t improve, I’ll contact the clinic.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: All right. Thanks for explaining everything.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. Thanks for explaining everything.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。
